title: Reads pinned to a past point see one consistent state of every memory
about: One memory is revised twice while a second memory is added between the revisions. A read pinned after step N returns, for every memory, the revision that was current after step N, and nothing for a memory that did not exist yet.

drafts.cognee: §3.5 historical reads are explicit and distinct from current reads
